title: Upgrading Extremal Flows in the Space of Derivatives
summary: The method of extremal flows has presented an alluring alternative approach to numerically solving bootstrap constraints. Here I present the development and adaptation of that approach to a more general class of flows with apparent discontinuities. I focus on upgrading solutions of gap maximization for the spinning modular bootstrap from low to high numerical order, though the methodology is generic to a broader class of bootstrap constraints and flows.
